sn10.11:1.2: ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane kalandaka-nivāpe || || 2.
sn10.11:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena aññataro upāsako Cīrāya bhikkhuniyā cīvaram adāsi || || 3.
sn10.11:1.4: Atha kho Cīrāya bhikkhuniyā abhippasanno yakkho Rājagahe rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā tayam velāyam imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
